Business intelligence services for small businesses

Business intelligence services that turn scattered data into monthly decisions

Data Fort helps small business owners in Toronto and the GTA organize operational data into dashboard reporting, KPI tracking, monthly business reporting, customer retention analysis, sales reporting, inventory reporting, and margin visibility. The service is tool-neutral and designed for independent pharmacies, retail and e-commerce stores, and beauty and wellness clinics.

What this service includes

  • Review of current reports, exports, spreadsheets, and business questions.
  • Definition of the KPIs that matter for ownership and staff decisions.
  • Dashboard structure for revenue, retention, inventory, service performance, and margins.
  • Plain-language insight summaries that connect the numbers to action.

Best-fit business questions

  • Which customers or patients are likely to lapse?
  • Which products, services, or categories are driving profitable growth?
  • Where is inventory moving slowly or creating avoidable stockout risk?
  • What should the team review every month before making operational decisions?
